## 💡 Feature Suggestion
A clear and concise description of what you would like to see added.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

Describe the solution you would like, including CLI syntax, WebUI components, or database rules if applicable.

## 📚 Alternative Approaches
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## 📖 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or metadata examples here.
